image_description: A close-up, shallow depth-of-field photograph of a pipe organ console. The foreground features a vertical row of cream-colored, mushroom-shaped stop knobs (drawknobs) mounted on a dark wooden jamb. In the background, blurred by bokeh, are multiple stacked keyboards (manuals) with black and white keys. The lighting is warm and artificial, highlighting the glossy finish of the stops.

The transition between the black and white keys in the blur zone shows slight 'smearing' rather than optical defocus, suggesting potential AI generation smoothing.
The lowest visible stop knob appears to merge slightly with the bottom edge of the frame and lacks a defined mounting base compared to the others above it, which have clear stems.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the geometry of the stop knobs. AI often struggles with the repetitive symmetry of these objects, causing them to warp or fuse. Also, scrutinize the background keyboards; do the black and white keys maintain their alternating pattern even in the blur, or does it become a nonsensical gray smear?
